summary.zh: 扫描代码安全与质量问题
summary.en: Scan code for security and quality issues

description.zh: 对仓库或代码片段运行规则扫描，返回安全漏洞、代码异味及规则说明。适合合并前做静态检查，或在对话里解释某条告警。首次连接用 Semgrep 账号在浏览器授权。
description.en: Run rule-based scans on repositories or snippets and get back findings plus rule explanations. Useful for pre-merge static checks or explaining a specific alert in conversation. Authorize with your Semgrep account in the browser on first connect.

authHint.zh: 首次连接在浏览器登录 Semgrep 并授权
authHint.en: Sign in to Semgrep and authorize on first connect
